content.intro: A field trip permission slip is a form that gives a parent or guardian's consent for a student to leave school on a trip and collects emergency contacts, medical and allergy notes, and lunch plans so teachers can supervise safely. This template puts the trip details at the top and ends with a typed parent name and consent box, so no slips get lost in backpacks.
content.audience: Teachers, school office staff, PTA trip coordinators, scout leaders and youth group organizers.
useCases: A class trip to a museum, zoo or science center
An overnight outdoor education or camp trip
A sports team traveling to an away tournament
A youth group outing to a theme park
tips: Edit the trip details block at the top for each outing, and set a closing date in Form Settings for the day slips are due.
Send replies to Google Sheets and match them against your class list to see who still needs to reply.
Turn on an email copy to the parent so families keep a record of what they agreed to.

faq.question: What should a field trip permission slip include?
faq.answer: The destination, date, departure and return times, transport and cost; the student's name and class; whether the child may attend; a parent or guardian contact for the day; allergies, medications and medical notes; lunch arrangements; and a typed parent name with a consent statement.

faq.question: Are online permission slips accepted instead of paper?
faq.answer: Many schools and districts accept online slips with a typed name and a consent box, but rules differ between districts, states and countries. Have your wording reviewed for your local rules and school policy before you use it.

faq.question: How do I ask parents to chaperone?
faq.answer: Add a question asking whether they can volunteer, as this template does. Parents who say yes leave a phone number, and you can follow up about any background check your school requires.

faq.question: Can I reuse this permission slip for every trip?
faq.answer: Yes. Change the trip details text and the due date for each outing. Each trip's replies stay in their own form, so records do not get mixed.

fields.content:
Trip: City Science Museum
Date: Friday, [date]
Leaves school: 9:00 am · Returns: 2:30 pm
Transport: School bus
Cost: $[amount], due to the school office by [date]

fields.label: May your child attend this trip?
options: No, my child will not attend

fields.label: Phone number on the trip day
Allergies, medical conditions or medication your child needs on the trip
fields.hint: Optional. Medication must be handed to the teacher in its original packaging

fields.label: Lunch
options: My child will bring a packed lunch
My child needs a school lunch

fields.label: Can you volunteer as a chaperone?

fields.content: I give permission for my child to take part in this trip and travel by the transport listed. I understand students must follow staff instructions. In an emergency, if I cannot be reached, I authorize staff to seek medical treatment for my child.

fields.label: Type your full name as the parent or guardian
Consent
options: I am the parent or legal guardian and I agree to the statement above
